gen-dafont-true-north-fs-rowan: A literary, friendly text serif with generous openings in every curve, thin strokes about half the weight of thick ones. Rowan carries the quiet reading, while True North, stocky and bold, takes the big statements.
gen-dafont-vcr-osd-mono-fs-epilogue: VCR OSD Mono sets a towering x-height in fixed-width, code-style letters, while Epilogue drifts in with curvy, wire-thin monoline strokes. Rigid, fixed-width order against loose, curvy freedom is the whole appeal.
gen-dafont-vcr-osd-mono-fs-fira-sans: A towering x-height gives VCR OSD Mono its lo-fi, code-style look. Fira Sans brings wide-opening s curves and uniform strokes, a clean, larger-bodied foil to the fixed-width heading above.
gen-dafont-verve-fs-hoover: Verve is tight and sharp, its bowls nearly sealed shut. Hoover, a refined serif with a generous e and compressed ascenders, would read with sturdy, open ease over many lines.
gen-dafont-verve-general-sans: General Sans reads smoothly, its curves unobstructed and its x-height filling the line. Verve brings brush-pressed stems and whisker-fine joins, and the tension against that open, uniform pen pressure is the draw.
gen-flavors-gf-quando: Stubby, towering and whimsical: Flavors hits like a thick carpenter's pencil stroke. Quando, bookish and widely spaced, does the quiet reading, while the heading shouts with commanding, flat-weight confidence.
gen-fredoka-fs-bespoke-slab: Fredoka is friendly, with an open e and no tapering at all. Bespoke Slab, grounded and refined, with tall-bodied lowercase, makes a full page of text feel steady and weighty underfoot.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-sofia-sans-semi-c: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed sets lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, in a true monoline stroke with open curves. Metamorphous handles the commanding display work while the body font handles the reading.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-stack-sans-text: Press Start 2P is fun and retro, with spacing like pinned cut-outs. It earns its keep big and brief, while Stack Sans Text keeps a modern, marker-like line with curve endings held well apart.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-savate: Gentle weight shifts and open-jawed curves read cleanly beside the flat technical-pen line of Love Ya Like A Sister. Savate rewards a slightly larger size, where its open curves and tall rounded o can really show.
